title: Anthropic · 更新日志来源更新
summary: 变更日志中关于 Claude Managed Agents 的说明文本有细微变化，但核心内容（自托管沙箱可附加 memory stores）未变，可能为措辞调整。

pairs.before: Claude Managed Agents sessions that run in a self-hosted sandbox can now attach memory stores. The Python, TypeScript, and Go SDK workers download each attached store into the sandbox at its mount_path and sync the agent's changes back to the store. See Use memory stores.
pairs.after: Claude Managed Agents sessions that run in a self-hosted sandbox can now attach memory stores. The Python, TypeScript, and Go SDK workers download each attached store into the sandbox at its mount_path and sync the agent's changes back to the store. See Memory stores in self-hosted sandboxes.
